status: prospectively frozen after exposed development and before independent outcomes
role: independent synthetic confirmation of protected-release incremental value under a predeclared persistent public-reference stress

stress_regime.name: persistent_regulatory_sensor_group_calibration_shift_4
stress_regime.scope: the fixed shift is applied to regulatory reference-observation values before public-model fitting and protected-query construction for the complete deployment; every arm scores the unchanged physical truth on identical support
transform_order: generate physical world and public regulatory observations
apply registered group shift to regulatory observations without reading truth
construct all protected mechanisms under that same reference
load truth only in isolated scorer
stress_regime.rationale: half the predeclared correction cap and below the residual clipping radius; a persistent public-sensor calibration offset rather than an outcome-selected event

evaluation.prediction_clock: causal publication clock; acquisition plus 24 epochs
evaluation.target: same four group means used by the fixed release mechanism and public-only comparator
evaluation.interval: paired-world one-sided 95 percent percentile bootstrap upper bound

decision_rules.primary_reference_stress: upper95(mean RMSE protected pool minus public-only) < 0
decision_rules.retained_raw_advantage: upper95(mean RMSE protected pool minus direct nonnegative raw DP carry) < 0; equally postprocessed nonnegative raw is also reported
decision_rules.main_regime: descriptive and always reported; no incremental-value claim unless its own upper95 difference is below 0
decision_rules.claim_rule: reference-stress claim only if both scientific bounds and every privacy, support, cadence and shared-resource invariant pass

observed_proxy_rule: seek a proxy only if an already valid, legally usable, unviewed split contains the same target plus public reference and can support a protected-release simulation without redefining admission; otherwise record no eligible split and do not fabricate one

artifacts.consumer_arrays: public inputs and protected release values only
artifacts.scoring_arrays: truth and predictions isolated from consumer invocation
